propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; jobs with always() predicates remain eligible and continue running even when the workflow run is superseded by a new patchset.

Seven full-route jobs introduced leading always() functions in commit 6f4123678c that prevent prompt cancellation when a same-change patchset replacement triggers cancel-in-progress, delaying successor job creation by 1,510+ seconds and consuming 1,785+ stale runner-seconds after replacement exists.

Replacing the leading always() with !cancelled() status checks preserves the docs-only contract (classifier failure still launches full fallback route as a blocking result) while enabling prompt cancellation of stale jobs on same-change supersession.

Live organic same-change replacement pairs (PS3→PS4 and PS4→PS5 for Gerrit change 1790) confirm stale full-route jobs now end canceled within 60–110 seconds of replacement creation, allowing successor jobs to begin without waiting for natural matrix completion.
